unit.explanation: 54 LCOs (organoid lines) from 36 patients whose DST regimen matched the clinical regimen (Table S6 rows).

readout.explanation: Per-record IC50 (uM) from ATP-luminance viability ratio on day 4 (Table S6 IC50 column).

direction.explanation: Low IC50 (e.g. P-41 0.10 uM, PR) = sensitive; high IC50 (e.g. P-59 4.37 uM, PD) = resistant.

threshold_rule.explanation: Binary sensitive/resistant call from ROC analysis with optimal threshold (Figure S3B).

threshold_timing.explanation: Threshold/consistency determined on the same 54 evaluated LCO-regimen records; no separate training cohort.

patient_mapping.explanation: Case IDs (P-17 etc.) and organoid IDs per row in Table S6.

regimen_match.explanation: LCO-DST regimen identical to the next-line clinical regimen used in the patient.

split.explanation: Single real-world cohort; accuracy reported on the same 54 records.

notes: Row-level assay call reconstructed per record as: predicted-sensitive = clinical response class when Consistency=YES, opposite class when Consistency=NO (Table S6 Consistency + Clinical Response columns); this recovers the Figure S3A 2x2 (TP21/FN4/FP5/TN24).
Accuracy = 45/54 = 0.833333 = published 83.33% (Figure S3A; article p101; Figure 3A consistent n=45/54).
Merged case/organoid ID cells (P-100, P-102, P-105) handled by regex split; censored IC50 values (>1000) not used as numeric scores.
